definitions_and_hypotheses_checked: Dimension is exactly three and all manifold carriers retain the stated smooth, Hausdorff/separation, measurable/Borel and second-countable instances.
The extinction time is an actual surgery time of the same stored flow and the terminal slice is empty.
The ledger is surgery_times intersected with Icc 0 H, not an independently selected event list.
Each local piece is compact and connected; survivor regions are component regions; empty events have no survivor piece.
Successor transport retains strict order, target horizon, minimality, predecessor equality, time-domain inclusion and no-surgery disjointness.
The conclusion enumerates the exact Sigma event/non-survivor index and assembles the same flow's time-zero slice.
substantive_proof_mechanisms: Compact-interval local finiteness and Finset conversion.
Finite minimum for the immediate successor; predecessor contradiction proves equality with the current event.
Regular-slab diffeomorphism and postcomposition of the actual survivor region equivalence.
Disjoint-union splitting and finite append; connected-sum operation lifting with an untouched extra carrier.
Reflexive/non-reflexive source transport and composition of relation chains.
Well-founded reverse induction with terminal no-survivor base, successor-tail bijection and first-event transport.
M82 tuple construction from the same M72 summand map and M73 factor maps, with no uniqueness assertion.
